name: B10-0087/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Boualem Sansal in Algeria
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Algeria to release Boualem Sansal, a 75-year-old French-Algerian novelist arrested in November 2024 and charged with "endangering the nation." It also asks Algeria to free all activists, journalists and human rights defenders jailed for speaking out. The Parliament says it is gravely concerned about growing repression of peaceful dissent in Algeria. It urges European Union institutions and member states to condemn this crackdown and raise individual cases with the Algerian authorities.

- The Parliament demands the release of Sansal and other jailed activists and journalists.
- It affects Algeria's government and people imprisoned for expressing their views.
- Next, the Parliament asks European Union bodies to press Algeria and support activists.
